import HartshorneLib.Chapter4HigherPoleResidue

/-!
# Compatibility of finite-pole residues

The fixed-parameter residue is unchanged on increasing the allowed pole
bound. Its order-zero member agrees with the intrinsic simple-pole residue
after transporting the lattice along the level-one identification.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- For a fixed parameter, increasing the pole bound does not change the
residue of a differential already in the smaller lattice. -/
theorem curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_add
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (n m : ℕ) (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht (n + m)
      ⟨ω, curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (by omega : n + 1 ≤ n + m + 1)
        ω.property⟩ = curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  have hlocal :
      curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + m + 1)
        ⟨ω, curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (by omega : n + 1 ≤ n + m + 1)
          ω.property⟩ = t ^ m • curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ω := by
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    simp only [map_smul, curvePoleLocalDifferential_map]
    rw [show n + m + 1 = m + (n + 1) by omega, pow_add, mul_smul]
  simp only [curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply, hlocal, map_smul,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Nat.add_comm n m, localTaylorCoefficient_add_parameter_pow_mul]

/-- Residue extraction is compatible with every inclusion of finite pole
lattices, while retaining the specified parameter. -/
theorem curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_mono
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht m
      ⟨ω, curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (Nat.add_le_add_right hnm 1)
        ω.property⟩ = curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω := by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  exact curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_add X hx t ht n i ω

theorem curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_zero_eq_simplePole
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x) :
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht 0
      ⟨ω, (curvePoleDifferentials_one X x).symm ▸ ω.property⟩ =
      curveSimplePoleResidueToBase X hx ω := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  rw [curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply]
  simp only [localTaylorCoefficient_zero]
  have hlocal :
      (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
          (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (0 + 1)
            ⟨ω, (curvePoleDifferentials_one X x).symm ▸ ω.property⟩) =
        (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
          (curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht ω) := by
    apply (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).injective
    apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
    simp [curvePoleLocalDifferential_map, curveSimplePoleLocalDifferential_map]
  rw [hlocal]
  rw [curveSimplePoleResidueToBase_apply, curveSimplePoleResidue_eq X hx t ht]
  rfl

end
end Hartshorne
